text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right before the race. Rulership's eyes looked more fiercely intense than usual today.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"—This lineup... post positions... track conditions.
Just as I thought... this is the only way it can unfold."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...I saw right through it! To absolute perfection!
And right at the center of it all... is me."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah... the decisive move.
The race development that "I created" after endless contemplation.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "By the time it's over, both the competitors running alongside her and the crowd will be utterly dumbfounded."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes wide open.
Before you can even blink... my plan will come to fruition.
